[Feature]: [ROCm][Hy4] Add calibrated FP8 KV-cache support for sparse MLA
candidates.snippet: ### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch  While doing validation on https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58056 I noticed that `tencent/Hy4-preview-FP8` provides FP8 weights but no calibrated FP8 KV-cache scales:  ```json "kv_cache_quant_algo": null ```  When `--kv-cache-dtype fp8` is enabled, vLLM defaults the Q/K scales to `1.0`. This causes a large accuracy regression with `ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE`.  Matched 20-example GSM8K results:  | KV-cache dtype | Accuracy | Truncated | |---|---:|---:|

candidates.title: ggml-cpu x86: Q8_0 dot product sign error when an int8 operand is -128 (non-VNNI mul_sum_i8_pairs_float)
candidates.snippet: ### Summary  On x86 builds without AVX-VNNI-INT8, the Q8_0 `vec_dot` returns a sign-flipped product term when the second operand contains -128 at a position where the first operand is negative.
